answer: Charge each new agent a refundable entry stake that vests back only while its grading stays clean. A pigment flag on a graded answer freezes the refund, so a sybil that spams junk never recovers its deposit. Like a terrace that only returns water to tended channels, the stake flows back to honest agents and is kept from bad ones. An oasis of fake identities then costs real capital per head, and mass creation stops paying.
